summary: T13 all-day semantics implementation is correct: serialization uses VALUE=DATE, parser rejects mixed DATE/DATE-TIME, edits preserve all-day kind, and DST-boundary dates round-trip unchanged. No defects found.
important_context: dst_check.rs is a diagnostic test for timed-event DST ambiguity (lossy round-trip), not an all-day defect; it is out of T13 scope and belongs to timed-event semantics (T04/T08).
